title: Compare shared and separate actor critic encoders
doing: Propose current shared transformer versus disjoint actor/critic encoders under the same selected control rate, reward and optimization settings. Declare initialization/Adam mapping, verify initial output parity where applicable, record parameter/FLOP/memory cost and use at least2 training seeds per cell. Separate scratch and warm-start evidence; no model construction or launch authorized.
expected: Separate encoders may reduce actor/value interference or improve fitting, but near-zero measured gradient alignment weakens a simple interference claim. Added capacity and cost may explain any improvement, so a beneficial result needs a parameter/compute-matched shared control before causal attribution.

evidence.label: User-directed literature checklist handoff; papers are priors, not Dodge results
